name: Supply Drone's [Class Bonus] recollection-phase Bullet materialize
notes: The global turn counter only increments when play cycles back to the first player (EndPhase: turnPlayer flips, then increments only if it equals firstPlayer again), so 'currentTurn===1' actually covers BOTH player 1's AND player 2's first turns -- player 2's first turn does NOT unblock RecollectionPhase/BeforeRecollectionPhase (confirmed by directly instrumenting the turn/phase state this session). Reaching a real recollection phase for player 2 needs a full cycle back to player 2's own second turn: player 1 ends turn 1, player 2 ends their (still turn-1) turn, player 1 declines their own MAT-phase materialize offer and ends their turn 2 (crossing back to player 1 increments the global counter to 2), then player 2 declines their own materialize offer before BeforeRecollectionPhase's per-card recollection check queues Supply Drone's materialize choice.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] At the beginning of your recollection phase, materialize a Bullet card with memory cost 0 from your material deck. (Apply this effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)
